name: Azeroth Companion
title: Living Azeroth Engine — Connected Armory & Item Codex
features: Connected Blizzard Item Codex: official item names, quality, equipment types, preview stats and effects by item ID
Read-only character Armory: retrieve public character data by region, realm slug and character name
Show equipped gear from Blizzard's profile equipment endpoint and inspect selected items in the Codex
Save up to 100 item wishlist entries and a local history of recently inspected equipment
Server credentials stay inside the existing Cloudflare Worker, never in GitHub Pages or browser storage
Retain all Genesis, Overdrive and Party Architect tools and their existing saved data
Handle API timeouts, unavailable characters, unsupported names and incomplete equipment responses without fabricating game data
Keep independent release validation and Discord announcement automation
